request.prompt: Use the licensed original photo as the sole identity and source-camera reference. Make a clean photorealistic catalog cutout of the SAME car, preserving paint color, exact body proportions, door/window layout, lamps, grille, wheels, mirrors, handles and visible trim/accessories. Keep the source camera, viewing direction and body style; do not mirror or invent an unseen opposite end. Clean dirt, scratches and surrounding-scene reflections. Remove environment, people, other vehicles, road, snow and advertising/plate characters. Keep realistic glass/interior and opaque bodywork. Show the COMPLETE car, all visible tires/mirrors and original roof accessories/antenna tips in a roomy frame with useful transparent space on all sides. True RGBA transparency, no floor/contact shadow, under-car reflection, glow, background fragments, captions, watermark or checkerboard. Do not add a shark fin or antenna type absent from the source. Do not infer engine specification or precise model year.  Keep the vehicle comfortably inside the frame with clearly visible transparent margins above every roof accessory, below every tire and beyond both ends; do not enlarge it up to the edges.  Distinguish target parts from every background neighbor. Never invent an antenna, roof rack or fin absent from the actual target. Remove fallen leaves and unrelated debris. Leave useful transparent space around all extremities; never crop tires, bumper corners or antenna tips. This exact YELLOW car is an OPEL ASTRA J GTC THREE-DOOR HATCHBACK, the2011-introduced GTC body that remained externally distinct during the J facelift era. Preserve two long side doors plus hatch/one near-side handle/large rear quarter glass, wide sloping coupe-like hatch tail, source black roof spoiler and black small roof fin, red swept rear lamps, dark lower rear bumper and original black/silver sport wheel pattern. KEEP SOURCE REAR-SIDE camera with nose toward RIGHT. Do not invent an unseen front, ordinary five-door rear body, OPC twin exhaust kit or newer Astra generation. Remove the big Opel DEALERSHIP DOOR ADVERTISEMENT and plate lettering, while retaining the genuine Opel lightning body badge/GTC markings and actual paint/body trim.
